newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian Coca bottler SFBT '96 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian Coca bottler SFBT '96 profits up.

text.p: Tunisian beverages firm Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis SFBT pre-tax profits for 1996 amounted to 4.109 million dinars, up from 3.231 million dinars in 1995, results published on Tuesday showed.
SFBT, which is the country's bottler for beer and Coca Cola, said its total assets were 107.688 million dinars in 1996.
Results of production amounted to 14.073 million dinars in 1996, up from 12.562 million dinars in 1995.
Liabilities as the end of 1996 included reserves of 24.806 million dinars, a short-term debt of 42.619 million dinars and a mid and long-term debt of 24.387 million dinars.
The firm has a capital of 9.5 million dinars, 20 percent of which was sold to the public at the Tunis Stock Exchange in 1995.
Its share was last priced 92.7 dinars at the Tunis Stock Exchange.
